_comment_distance_threshold: distance_threshold is per-dataset (not in defaults), set so both datasets target roughly the same ~14.28um physical neighbourhood, not the same pixel count. IMMUcan: 14.28px at the project's long-standing ~1um/px assumption (never independently confirmed -- see HANDOFF). cHL: 31.73px = 14.28um / 0.45um/px, where 0.45um/px is Julia's figure (not independently verifiable from this dataset's files -- no PhysicalSize in the OME-XML, no real TIFF resolution tag, only a placeholder XResolution=(1,1)). The segmentation folder name's 'mpp1.75' was considered and NOT used here -- it most likely describes a segmentation-model target resolution, not the raw acquisition mpp, but this was never independently confirmed either.

immucan._comment_excluded_channels: Channel indices follow CellTypes/channels.txt's line order exactly (0-indexed): 1=HistoneH3, 38=DNA1, 39=DNA2 -- same nuclear/housekeeping exclusion as every other method.
immucan._comment_no_label_map: There is no hardcoded label_map here -- the int-to-phenotype mapping is read directly from labels_csv (CellTypes/labels_cell_type.csv) via the same load_label_map() every other FM method already uses, instead of re-copying that table into every method's config where it can silently drift out of sync.

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_folds_dir: fold_indices.json's own 'train'/'test' integer lists are NOT consistent row positions into the master quantification CSV -- they come from create_validation_set_from_fold()'s per-fold-file reset index. The per-fold fold_{i}_train.csv/fold_{i}_test.csv files are read directly instead, keyed by sample_id+cell_id. Same approach as eva.json/kronos.json/virtues.json/kronos2.json and the classic_ml baseline.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_excluded_markers: Must match the exact filenames under single_channel_dir / lines in markers.txt -- 'anti-H2AX' alone (no suffix) silently fails to match 'anti-H2AX (pS139)' and would NOT be excluded.
